Who can register a .app domain?
Anyone. There are no eligibility requirements, so solo developers, startups, and global brands can all register a .app domain for their product.
Do I need an SSL certificate for a .app domain?
Yes. Every .app domain is on the HSTS preload list, which means browsers will only load .app sites over a secure HTTPS connection. Your site needs an SSL certificate before it will load. Many registrars and hosting providers include one, and free certificates are widely available.

In this no-holds-barred guide, we will break down AI chatbot development cost by type, region, AI model, and all the factors that push prices up or down. After going through this guide, you can judge reasonable quotes and separate them from overpriced ones.
Quick Answer
How much does AI chatbot development cost in 2026? 
AI chatbot development costs range from $3,000–$25,000 for a simple rule-based bot to $150,000–$500,000+ for an enterprise or agentic AI assistant. Most mid-market businesses building a custom, LLM-powered chatbot should budget $40,000–$150,000, plus 15–20% of that annually for maintenance.

AI Hosting Costs in 2026: APIs, Serverless GPUs and Dedicated Servers Compared
Published on July 2, 2026 by Steven Jones
AI hosting costs can range from less than $20 per month for a small application using a hosted model API to several thousand dollars per month for dedicated production GPUs. The hourly GPU price is only one part of the bill. Idle capacity, model loading, databases, storage, retries, monitoring and engineering work can change which route is genuinely cheapest.
